strategy_roster.name: Color Trend CF
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(12) versus twice-length EMA(24) implements the source's fast/slow crossover structure; 12 is a fallback because Period has no supplied value. Price-unit stop and target values are not provided.

strategy_roster.name: Kalman Filter Candles
strategy_roster.notes: Separately smoothed close and open series approximate the two Kalman streams and retain bullish and bearish color changes. EMA length 10 is an explicit fallback for the unspecified process noise; exact adaptive filtering is unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: 3100 Close All Positions
strategy_roster.notes: This supervisory utility never opens positions, so impossible price guards deliberately prevent fabricated trades. Portfolio floating-profit thresholds, child strategies, and flattening state cannot be represented.

strategy_roster.name: Stochastic Diff
strategy_roster.entry_long: roc(ema(sma(100 * (close - donchian_low(low,14)) / (donchian_high(high,14) - donchian_low(low,14)),3) - sma(sma(100 * (close - donchian_low(low,14)) / (donchian_high(high,14) - donchian_low(low,14)),3),3),3),1) > 0
strategy_roster.exit_long: roc(ema(sma(100 * (close - donchian_low(low,14)) / (donchian_high(high,14) - donchian_low(low,14)),3) - sma(sma(100 * (close - donchian_low(low,14)) / (donchian_high(high,14) - donchian_low(low,14)),3),3),3),1) < 0
strategy_roster.notes: A 14-bar range-position oscillator, nested 3-bar %K/%D smoothing, and 3-bar EMA retain the stochastic difference; a positive one-bar change approximates its trough turn upward. All periods and percent protections are fallbacks because values are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: AbsolutelyNoLagLWMA Digit MMRec
strategy_roster.notes: Double EMA(14) is a no-lag WMA proxy, and its one-bar slope chooses the bullish module. WMA weighting, digit rounding, three timeframe modules, and point/queue money management are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Constituents EA
strategy_roster.notes: The pending-order system is represented by its stop-order breakout branch using a 20-bar prior range. Start hour, limit/stop mode selection, pip buffers, freeze levels, and protection have no supplied numeric values.

strategy_roster.name: Synchronized Hour Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: A 20-bar high break with positive ten-bar momentum approximates the recent bullish/bearish balance breakout. The 19:00/22:00 hour gate, offsets, order cap, and point exits are omitted and 20/10 are fallbacks.

strategy_roster.name: Bounce Strength Index
strategy_roster.notes: Close position in the 14-bar range with SMA(3) then SMA(10) reproduces the double-smoothed Bounce Strength Index. Parameters are absent, so 14/3/10 are explicit fallbacks.

strategy_roster.name: RangeEA Weekly Grid
strategy_roster.notes: A long pullback below the midpoint and exit at the upper edge approximate one level of the weekly limit grid. Weekly bars, order count, time window, dynamic offsets, and 60-point protections are not represented.

strategy_roster.name: Fibonacci Time Zones
strategy_roster.notes: A bullish MACD(12/26) cross above the Bollinger midpoint selects the long branch and an opposite filter or upper band exits. Time zones, higher-timeframe confirmation, discretionary entries, and pip/money management are unavailable; lengths are fallbacks.
